description: A polished Phaser platform-jumping game with illustrated bunny, carrot, cloud, and grass-platform artwork, tactile hold-and-release controls, three route lengths, missed-landing recovery, and instant free local play. The wallet-backed reward lane remains gated until the deployed contract and Morpheus session protocol pass end-to-end production validation.
description_zh: 精心打磨的 Phaser 平台跳跃游戏，拥有插画小兔、胡萝卜、云朵与草地平台资源、按住蓄力松手起跳的手感、三种路线长度、落空恢复和即时免费本地游玩。钱包奖励路线将在已部署合约与 Morpheus 会话协议通过端到端生产验证后开放。
name: Jump Rush

operation_panel.subtitle: Launch the game, choose a route, hold to charge, and release to jump. Free practice never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Jump Rush

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Free practice is local and makes no oracle request. The reward route stays gated until its deployed engine and contract rules are aligned and validated end to end.

tee.description: Free practice is local and makes no TEE request. Morpheus settlement remains a gated future lane until production validation is complete.
